site.title: Lico's Awesome Archive
site.tagline: my little corner of the interest. games, experiments, and other stuff i made to learn things.
about: hi, i'm Lico! welcome to my utility website and little showcase.
this is where i keep the games and experiments i make for fun, along with the utility websites i use every day.
i miss the desktops of around 2007, so this site is mostly here for my own nostalgia.
some of my games are finished, some are prototypes, and some are parked because they already taught me what i wanted. all of them are a little dumb.
play around with stuff here: Paint, Sticky Notes, Workstation and more.
